a2-11-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Last Weekend
a2-11-01.scenario: On Monday at the language exchange in Hanoi, Lucía asks what you did at the festival last weekend. You danced and you celebrated a tradition with your friends.
a2-11-01.prompt: Tell Lucía that you danced at the festival and that you celebrated a tradition with your friends.
cues: Say what you did at the festival
Say what you celebrated and with whom
a2-11-01.target: Bailé en el festival y celebré una tradición con mis amigos.
a2-11-01.english: I danced at the festival and I celebrated a tradition with my friends.
a2-11-01.canDo: I can describe completed past events using regular pretérito indefinido forms.

a2-11-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Good Day
a2-11-02.scenario: After the festival in Hanoi, Meg asks how your day was. You went to the festival, you had a good day and you took many photographs.
a2-11-02.prompt: Tell Meg that you went to the festival, that you had a good day and that you took many photographs.
cues: Say what you did with the camera
a2-11-02.target: Fui al festival y tuve un buen día. Hice muchas fotografías.
a2-11-02.english: I went to the festival and I had a good day. I took many photographs.
a2-11-02.canDo: I can describe what happened at a festival using common irregular pretérito indefinido forms.

a2-11-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What Did You Do?
a2-11-03.scenario: You meet Kaylee in Hanoi after the festival. You want to know what she did yesterday and what she bought.
a2-11-03.prompt: Ask Kaylee what she did yesterday and what she bought.
a2-11-03.english: What did you do yesterday? What did you buy?
a2-11-03.canDo: I can ask and answer questions about completed past events.

a2-11-04.title: Communicative Challenge: My Day in Order
a2-11-04.scenario: Lucía asks you to tell her your day at the festival in order. First you visited the festival, afterwards you bought a fan, and in the afternoon you went to the concert.
a2-11-04.prompt: Tell Lucía your day in order: first you visited the festival, afterwards you bought a fan, and in the afternoon you went to the concert.
cues: Say what you did in the afternoon
a2-11-04.target: Primero visité el festival. Después compré un abanico. Por la tarde fui al concierto.
a2-11-04.english: First I visited the festival. Afterwards I bought a fan. In the afternoon I went to the concert.
a2-11-04.canDo: I can sequence completed events when recounting a day at a festival.

a2-11-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Festival in the City
a2-11-05.scenario: Back in the flat, Carlos asks you to recount the festival in the city. You went to the festival, you tried a traditional sweet, you bought a fan and in the afternoon you were at a concert.
a2-11-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what happened at the festival: where you went, what you tried and bought, and where you were in the afternoon.
cues: Say what you tried and what you bought
Say where you were in the afternoon
a2-11-05.target: Primero fui al festival. Probé un dulce tradicional y compré un abanico. Por la tarde estuve en un concierto.
a2-11-05.english: First I went to the festival. I tried a traditional sweet and I bought a fan. In the afternoon I was at a concert.
a2-11-05.canDo: I can recount what happened during a recent festival using regular and irregular pretérito indefinido.

a2-11-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: My Festival Day
a2-11-consolidation.scenario: On Sunday Daniela asks about your day at the festival in Hanoi with your friends. You went with your friends, you danced first and afterwards you took many photographs.
a2-11-consolidation.prompt: Tell Daniela that you went to the festival with your friends, that you danced first and that afterwards you took many photographs.
cues: Say where you went and with whom
a2-11-consolidation.target: Fui al festival con mis amigos. Primero bailé y después hice muchas fotografías.
a2-11-consolidation.english: I went to the festival with my friends. First I danced and afterwards I took many photographs.
a2-11-consolidation.canDo: I can use the pretérito indefinido to recount a day at the festival.
